title: Mask Style Established by Interface and Cushion Lines, PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
## Fitting rule

For an enrollment in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, the style the enrollment's lines establish is read as follows. Every interface and cushion line on the enrollment shipped in the last month is read — lines billed to coverage, lines paid by the patient and no-charge lines alike. The cushion item of the newest such cushion line is the candidate, and the recorded style changes to the candidate's style only when four or more such lines of the candidate item were shipped in that span; otherwise the recorded style stays.

A full face cushion (A7031) belongs to the full face style, a nasal cushion (A7032) to the nasal style and a pair of nasal pillows (A7033) to the nasal pillows style.

**The span.** One calendar month read back from the handling day: a line is in the span when its ship date is fewer than 1 whole calendar month before the handling day.

**Lines, not units.** The four lines are counted as lines, whatever the units on each.

## Outcomes

| Lines of the candidate item in the span | Recorded style |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | changes to the candidate's style |
| 3 or fewer | stays |
| no cushion line in the span | stays |

## Worked examples (hypothetical lines, handling day 20 May; the span runs from 21 April)

- Nasal cushion (A7032) lines on 24 April, 1 May, 8 May and 15 May; recorded style full face. The newest cushion line is A7032, which has 4 lines in the span: the style changes to nasal.
- Same lines plus a full face cushion (A7031) line on 18 May: the newest cushion line is now A7031, which has 1 line in the span; the recorded style stays.
- A nasal cushion line dated 20 April is outside the span (one whole month before 20 May) and is not read.
